evidence: PILOT-001-R5-001 shows that ready-state validation checks base existence but not base-to-HEAD ancestry or scope.
Git arguments remain structured, diagnostics remain redacted, and canonical path/link containment remains enforced.
PILOT-001-R5-001 leaves the planned-to-ready clean-base transition guard incomplete.
Aggregate references, total blob bytes, per-file bytes, changed paths, and process-driving collections are bounded.
Shared budget and revision helpers avoid duplicate hashing and revision checks without an actionable style issue.
The ready fixture proves null-candidate acceptance but omits divergent-base and post-base production-scope cases.

findings.expectedBehavior: A ready packet binds its current committed metadata HEAD to the declared base: HEAD descends from the base and base-to-HEAD changes are confined to canonical ticket metadata.
findings.observedBehavior: The validator checks only that the declared base commit exists, then returns before reading HEAD or checking ancestry and changed-path scope.
findings.reproduction: Commit an otherwise valid ready packet on a divergent branch or after a production-file commit while naming any existing unrelated or stale base; the null-candidate path accepts it.
findings.impact: A ticket can become ready from a stale or unrelated tree, so later RED and candidate comparisons do not prove isolation from the true starting revision.
findings.requiredRemediation: Resolve HEAD for a null-candidate packet, require the declared base to be its ancestor, and reject every base-to-HEAD path outside the canonical ticket metadata directory.
findings.verification: Add real-Git ready fixtures for metadata-only success, divergent-base rejection, post-base production rejection, and an unchanged candidate-phase control.

notes: The independent reviewer ran in an ephemeral read-only Codex session. Its Deno commands were blocked before process start, so only successful read-only Git commands are recorded here.
Historical round-one and round-two frozen-test violations remain bootstrap history and are not candidate-scope findings.
